_comment: plan-generic-kill-quests.md C1 — the Wanderer's kill quest. The kobold nest (26 spawns, x -24..-9, y -5..25) actually sits by the WANDERER; the-lost-lamp's giver is 30+ units from it. Target measured: 13 Kobold L7 (+4 KoboldRanged L6) within 7-21 units of the Wanderer's authored point (-15.5, 30.7) — who wanders (spawn randomised up to 4 units + wanderRadius 4), which is fine: the nest is wide. The species overlap with the-lost-lamp is deliberate and mechanically clean — both objectives baseline independently at stage entry (N4/D4), so running both at once double-credits, which reads as generosity. The brief says 'the road', not the tunnel — the tunnel framing belongs to the lamp quest. Reward on the turn-in row (wanderer.json): 450 XP = the L9 half-level rule at L7. Text deliberately plain (PO 2026-08-02: no lore or stylized quest text yet).
